sloka: आदित्यः सविता सूर्यः खगः पूषा गभस्तिमान् ।सुवर्णसदृशो भानुर्हिरण्यरेता दिवाकरः ।। ६.१०७.१० ।।
transliteration: ādityaḥ savitā sūryaḥ khagaḥ pūṣā gabhastimān ।suvarṇasadṛśo bhānurhiraṇyaretā divākaraḥ ।। 6.107.10 ।।

translations.english: "You are the son of Aditi, the sungod, creator Savitha, the courser in the heavens, the sustainer, the possessor of golden rays, Bhanu, shining with golden rays, the Sun god.
